title: verify-index
summary: Measures drag-lint resolution against DelphiLSP: samples resolved references and reports the mismatch rate and the rows
intro: Internal measurement verb: takes a deterministic sample of resolved references from one project index, asks DelphiLSP where each name is declared, and reports how often the two disagree; read-only, needs a .delphilsp.json.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint verify-index (--db <db> | --project <x.dproj>) [--delphi-lsp-config <file>] [--sample N] [--seed N] [--delphi-lsp <exe>] [--delphi-lsp-bits 32|64] [--timeout-ms N] [--warmup-ms N] [--trace <file>] [--dry-run] [--json] (internal: mismatch rate of the index vs DelphiLSP)

questions.ask: How often does the index resolve a name differently from the compiler?

notes: internal: 1.53.0 slice of LSP1-VERIFY; read-only; needs a .delphilsp.json (RAD Studio writes it when the project is opened).
